LanguageData.TMM.Services.AutoAreas: Automatic management needs only the overall territory and optional staff-only rooms. Guest access is derived automatically. An enclosed room becomes a ward when a bed is marked Medical; keep visitor wards outside staff-only rooms.
LanguageData.TMM.Services.HotelHelp: Set the daily room rate and guest admission rules here. These switches permit visits; they do not immediately summon a group. Visits are scheduled in advance and depend on conditions. The list below covers visitors on this map. Select territory and staff rooms under General.
LanguageData.TMM.Services.ClinicHelp: Admission requires an enclosed ward with medical beds inside the complex, a doctor and patient admission enabled. Check the hours below: new patients can arrive during open hours, with a random chance. Allowing surgery does not itself open admission. Existing patients continue treatment after admission closes.
LanguageData.TMM.Services.RestaurantHelp: Build a service counter inside the complex and assign a waiter under Staff. A cook prepares the selected meal in advance. Waiters check complex fridges first, then accessible colony fridges. Separate seating and stock areas are not required.
LanguageData.TMM.Services.HoursHelp: New-patient admission hours. Green is open; grey is closed. Click an hour to toggle it.
LanguageData.TMM.Services.HourTip: Local time {0}:00–{1}:00. Click to allow or block new-patient arrival during this hour.
LanguageData.TMM.Services.NextGuest: Next scheduled guest visit: approximately {0} hours. Arrival depends on map access and admission rules.
LanguageData.TMM.Services.NoGuestVisit: No scheduled guest visits are queued yet. The game checks scheduling periodically; enabling admission does not immediately summon a group.
